messages:
Isha B: quick flag from backup-finder: found an archive in partner S3 containing Vault sealed blobs: s3://partner-exports/redwood/2026-03-22/export-sealed-v1.tar.gz
Tom R: paste object metadata & any ACLs? which KMS key was used for wrapping?
Isha B: metadata shows uploader=partner-sync-sa@partner-prod, acl=private, kms-wrap-key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/cmek-kr/cryptoKeys/cmek-wrap-hsm. crc32: 9f8e7d
oncall-bot: ALERT: sealed-blob-external-upload detected for partner-sync-sa (rule: sealed-blob-scan)
Zoe L: risk model: sealed blobs are fine if the wrapping key cannot be used by that SA. first order: revoke any decrypt grants, snapshot key IAM & audit logs, and quarantine object. I'll take revoke + logs.
Isha B: running commands to snapshot & quarantine now:
```
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy cmek-wrap-hsm --location=global --keyring=cmek-kr > /tmp/cmek-policy-before.json
aws s3 cp s3://partner-exports/redwood/2026-03-22/export-sealed-v1.tar.gz s3://sec-quarantine/partner-export-2026-03-22.tar.gz
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding cmek-wrap-hsm --location=global --keyring=cmek-kr --member="serviceAccount:partner-sync-sa@partner-prod" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
```
Tom R: good. also export KMS usage logs to BigQuery and forward Vault audit to SIEM (we need cross-correlation). I'll open a support ticket with HSM vendor in case key rotation has constraints.
Zoe L: creating incident INC-2026-099 (sev: medium). immediate containment done at 12:03 UTC. next: token accessor sweep for any Vault accessors tied to partner IPs, create new key version (rotate) and implement a canary rewrap job that uses a dry-run mode first.
Isha B: started token sweep: `vault token revoke -accessor=<accessor>` for 6 accessors found correlated to partner-sync-sa. Also uploaded the IAM snapshot to gs://ops/audit/cmek-policy-before-3501239999.json
Partner-OPS: partner confirms this was an automated export from a staging cron; they will pause the job and share the cron config. no confirmed external access.
Tom R: remediation checklist: block direct cryptoKeyDecrypter grants in onboarding pipelines, add a signed grant flow for partners requiring short-lived grants (grant CLI with expiry), add CI gate requiring infra-security approval for any onboarding role changes.
Zoe L: will add an automated test to onboarding CI that rejects PRs granting kms:decrypt to service accounts unless a review label is present. PR ETA 2h.
Isha B: canary rewrap dry-run passed for 30 objects; one path mapping issue found and fixed. planning full rotate + rewrap in 24h after legal & partner ops notify.
Tom R: add post-incident item: increase Vault audit retention to 180 days for cross-tenant investigations and document wrap-key rotation runbook (including HSM vendor steps).
oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-099 assigned to Zoe L, Isha B (severity: medium)
Isha B: tracking moved to INC-2026-099. closing this chat thread to reduce noise, will post updates in the incident ticket and the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
